description: a cylinder standing on a box's face (boss-flush's contact at the band survey's numbers and pose), lifted a tolerance (1e-7) off it. Arris fails: the cap and the plate's face, a hair off parallel once posed, have no closed form (OpError::Unsupported, plane against plane); the survey's own build of the same pair, posed by its quaternion rather than this recipe's axis and angle, gave a union that fails the checker, and unposed it is the flush body. The desired result is the flush body, as unposed (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
